branches_lat_lng_check.name: branches_lat_lng_check
branches_lat_lng_check.value: ("branches"."lat" IS NULL AND "branches"."lng" IS NULL) OR ("branches"."lat" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "branches"."lng" BETWEEN -180 AND 180)

branches_scheduling_check.name: branches_scheduling_check
branches_scheduling_check.value: "branches"."schedule_lead_minutes" BETWEEN 15 AND 2880 AND "branches"."schedule_max_days" BETWEEN 1 AND 14 AND ("branches"."slot_capacity" IS NULL OR "branches"."slot_capacity" >= 1)

merchants_transfer_details_check.name: merchants_transfer_details_check
merchants_transfer_details_check.value: NOT "merchants"."accepts_transfer" OR (("merchants"."transfer_alias" IS NOT NULL OR "merchants"."transfer_cbu" IS NOT NULL) AND "merchants"."transfer_holder" IS NOT NULL)

orders_delivery_address_check.name: orders_delivery_address_check
orders_delivery_address_check.value: "orders"."fulfillment_type" = 'PICKUP' OR ("orders"."delivery_address_line" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."delivery_zone_name" IS NOT NULL)

deliveries_courier_check.name: deliveries_courier_check
deliveries_courier_check.value: "deliveries"."status" NOT IN ('ASSIGNED', 'ARRIVING_PICKUP', 'PICKED_UP', 'ARRIVING_DROPOFF', 'DELIVERED') OR "deliveries"."courier_id" IS NOT NULL
